name: Metal Empire
description: Machine, cyborg, or other mechanical Digimon. Can represent cities and factories.

name: Nature Spirits
description: Generic monsters and beasts. Also represents grasslands and canyons.

name: Nightmare Soldiers
description: Darkness or spirit based Digimon, or Digimon based on traditional "Halloween" monsters like vampires, werewolves, or Japanese youkai and demons. Can represent haunted or cursed areas.

name: Unknown
description: Mutant, unusual, or strange Digimon. Can represent junkyards and other strange places.

name: Dark Area
description: Villainous, demonic, terrifying, evil Digimon. Can represent the Dark Area of the Digital World.

name: Wind Guardians
description: Flying, air, or plant based Digimon. Can represent forests and the sky.

name: Deep Savers
description: Aquatic or ice-related Digimon. Can represent the ocean or arctic.

name: Virus Busters
description: Heroic or angelic Digimon, often includes main characters from the anime or manga. Can represent the sky or heavens.
